_why: One expectation set per fixture. bin/conformance asserts these against bin/baseline's --json output. A fixture with no entry FAILS rather than being skipped: an unasserted fixture is a directory, not a test.

f1-foreign-generator.note: generator uses forge:, not origin: — owner census is blind, families are not

f2-two-generators.note: two generators; succession must name which

f3-hand-authored.note: no markers anywhere; RETAIN rule 3 is correct here

f4-markerless-generator.note: no family, no attribute — out-of-band evidence only

f6-greenfield-codebase.note: the primary path; needs fixtures/init-git.sh for the commit signal

f7-edited-generated-blocks.note: a user has edited inside a machine-owned block; the sidecar hash is the only tell

f8-name-collisions.note: one name defined four times across three scopes

f9-half-migrated.note: orphan closer, an orphaned skill dir correctly quarantined, dead hook wiring, WRITE-INTENT row

f10-verified-ledger.note: hand-counted in TRUTH.md — the one number the census cannot fabricate; index drifts by 2

f11-verified-datasets-hooks.note: hand-classified in TRUTH.md — dataset and hook censuses; two settings scopes, a path inside a bash arg

f12-verified-markers.note: hand-counted in TRUTH.md — the extraction gate's denominator; fences, backticks, comment prefixes, non-SKILL.md files

f13-sibling-ledgers.note: hand-counted in TRUTH.md — two sibling skills make `skills/` itself match the ledger shape; the ancestor must lose. Index states no counts, which is not a claim of zero

f14-mentioned-not-present.note: hand-counted in TRUTH.md — the generic family detector must anchor like the totals do; a family named in a table cell or mid-sentence is a mention, and classifying a phantom into the marker table authorizes a sweep over it

f15-markers-outside-skills.note: hand-counted in TRUTH.md — org embed writes into handbooks and audit writes into CLAUDE.md, so a detector scoped to skills/ is blind to half of what this project emits
